दरवार हत्याकाण्डका भयावह र कमै सुनिएका पाटाहरू उजागर गरेकी थिइन् । आफैं गोली लागेर घाइतेकी भएकी उनले तत्कालीन सभामुख तारानाथ रानाभाट नेतृत्वको उच्चस्तरीय जाँचबुझ समितिमा हत्याकाण्ड दीपेन्द्रले गराएका विवरणहरु पेश गरेकी थिइन् भने केही समयपछि बीबीसी र नेपाली टाइम्सलाई दिएका अन्तर्वार्तामा पनि उनले यस्ता केही खुलासा गरेकी थिइन् । तत्कालीन राजा वीरेन्द्रका काका बसुन्धराकी छोरी (बहिनी) केतकी चेस्टरले दीपेन्द्रले रक्सीले मातेको अभिनय मात्र गरेको बताएकी थिइन् । दरबार हत्याकाण्डकी एक जीवित साक्षी राजकुमारी केतकीको निधन – Nepal Press घटनाको बेला आफ्नी दिदी जयन्तीसँगै बिलियर्ड कोठाको ढोकाछेउ उभिएकी चेस्टरका अनुसार दीपेन्द्र सैनिक पोसाक र दुवै हातमा बन्दूक बोकेर भित्र पसेका थिए । राजा वीरेन्द्रले छोराले हतियार देखाउन ल्याएको ठानेका थिए, तर दीपेन्द्रले एक्कासि गोली चलाए । भुइँमा ढल्नुअघि राजा वीरेन्द्रले ‘के गरेको ?’ मात्र भन्न भ्याए । चेस्टरले भनेकी छन्-मलाई सबैभन्दा बढी बिझाएको र अझै पनि दिमागमा ताजा रहेको दृश्य के हो भने- गोली हानिसकेपछि दीपेन्द्रले भुइँमा लडिरहेका आफ्ना बुबालाई लात्तीले हाने । हाम्रो संस्कृतिमा मृत वा मरणासन्न व्यक्तिलाई त्यसरी कहिल्यै अपमान गरिँदैन, जुन गोली हान्नुभन्दा पनि बढी स्तब्ध पार्ने घटना थियो । काका धीरेन्द्रको हत्यापछि अनियन्त्रित बने दीपेन्द्र चेस्टरको बुझाइमा दीपेन्द्रको मुख्य उद्देश्य आफ्ना बुबालाई मात्र मारेर कानुनतः राजा बन्ने र अरूलाई चुप लगाउने थियो । तर, दोस्रो पटक कोठामा पस्दा अधिराजकुमार धीरेन्द्रले ‘पुग्यो बाबु, तिमीले धेरै गरिसक्यौ’ भन्दै सम्झाउन खोज्दा हतियार खोस्न लागेको ठानेर दीपेन्द्रले उनलाई गोली हाने । आफ्ना प्यारा काकालाई आफूले नै मारेको महसुस भएपछि दीपेन्द्र पूर्ण रूपमा अनियन्त्रित बनेको र तेस्रो पटक पसेर कोठाभरि अन्धाधुन्ध गोली बर्साएको चेस्टरले बताएकी थिइन् । सोही क्रममा चेस्टरको दाहिने कुममा दुईवटा गोली लाग्यो भने बायाँ पाखुराको मासु नै उछिट्टियो । गोलीबारी चलिरहँदा युवराज पारसले आफन्तहरूलाई सोफापछाडि लुकाएर बचाएका थिए । चेष्टरका अनुसार दीपेन्द्रले पारसलाई पनि ताकेका थिए, तर पारसले दाइ मलाई नहानिबक्स्योस भनेपछि दीपेन्द्रले बन्दुक तल झारेका थिए । ज्ञानेन्द्र र पारस निर्दोष, गिरिजाप्रसाद कोइरालामाथि प्रश्न आफ्नो बयानमा चेस्टरले तत्कालीन अधिराजकुमार ज्ञानेन्द्र र युवराज पारसको हत्याकाण्डमा कुनै संलग्नता नरहेको दावी गरेकी छन् । पोखरामा रहेका ज्ञानेन्द्रलाई लिन गएको हेलिकप्टर खराब मौसमले उड्न नसकेपछि सेनाले सडकमार्गबाट काठमाडौँ ल्याएको र ज्ञानेन्द्र त्यो रात दरबारमा भएको भए उनी पनि मारिने निश्चित रहेको चेस्टरको भनाइ छ । यसका साथै, उनले तत्कालीन प्रधानमन्त्री गिरिजाप्रसाद कोइरालाले सत्यतथ्य लुकाएर गम्भीर गल्ती गरेको आरोप लगाएकी थिइन् । उनका अनुसार भोलिपल्ट छाउनी अस्पताल पुगेका प्रधानमन्त्री कोइरालाले जनतालाई के भनूँ ? भनी सोध्दा मुमा बडामहारानी रत्नले ‘सत्य नलुकाउनु, यसले परिवारको प्रतिष्ठामा दाग लागे पनि देशलाई हानि गर्दैन’ भन्ने जवाफ दिएकी थिइन् । तर, सञ्चारमाध्यममा लगाइएको प्रतिबन्ध र सभामुख तारानाथ रानाभाटको पत्रकार सम्मेलनले सत्य ओझेलमा पारी भ्रम र षड्यन्त्रका सिद्धान्तहरू फैलाएको चेस्टरको दाबी थियो । अधुरो पश्चात्ताप पहिलो गोली चल्नेबित्तिकै दीपेन्द्रलाई झम्टिएर समात्न नसकेकोमा आफूलाई सधैँ पछुतो लागिरहने चेस्टरले नेपाली टाइम्ससँगको अन्तर्वार्तामा बताएकी छिन् । उनले भनेकी थिइन्–आजसम्म पनि मेरो सबैभन्दा ठूलो पछुतो के हो भने, त्यो रात दीपेन्द्रले पहिलो गोली चलाउनेबित्तिकै हामीले उनलाई झम्टिएर समात्न सकेनौँ। त्यसो नगरेकोमा म आफैँलाई धिक्कार्छु,यदि हामीले छिटो कदम चालेको भए यति धेरै मानिसको ज्यान जाने थिएन। Kathmandu. Ketki Chester, one of the eyewitnesses to the horrific massacre that took place at the Narayanhiti Royal Palace on the night of 19th Jestha, 2058 BS, is no more. Ketki, who passed away at the age of 80, had exposed the horrific and rarely heard aspects of the palace massacre. She, who herself was injured by a bullet, presented details of the murders committed by Dipendra to the high-level inquiry committee led by then Speaker Taranath Ranabhat, and some time later, she also made some such revelations in interviews given to the BBC and Nepali Times. Ketaki Chester, the daughter (sister) of the then King Birendra's uncle Basundhara, revealed in an interview with journalist Kunda Dixit that Crown Prince Dipendra had also kicked her father, King Birendra, who had fallen after being shot by him. In that memoir, she stated that the palace massacre was well-planned and that Dipendra was only acting drunk. According to Chester, who was standing by the door of the billiard room with her sister Jayanti at the time of the incident, Dipendra entered wearing a military uniform and carrying a gun in both hands. King Birendra thought his son had brought the weapon to show off, but Dipendra suddenly opened fire. King Birendra could only say, "What did you do?" before collapsing to the ground. Chester said, "The scene that struck me the most and is still fresh in my mind is when, after shooting, Dipendra kicked his father, who was lying on the ground. In our culture, a dead or dying person is never insulted in that way, which was even more shocking than the shooting." Dipendra became uncontrollable after the murder of his uncle Dhirendra. Chester understood that Dipendra's main goal was to kill his father and become the legitimate king and silence others. However, when he entered the room for the second time, Adhirajkumar Dhirendra tried to explain by saying, "Enough, father, you have done too much," and Dipendra shot him, thinking he was trying to snatch his weapon. Chester said that Dipendra became completely uncontrollable after realizing that he had killed his beloved uncle and entered the room a third time and fired indiscriminately. During the same incident, Chester was hit twice in the right thigh and the flesh of his left arm was torn off. While the shooting was going on, Yubaraj Paras had saved his relatives by hiding behind the sofa. According to Chester, Dipendra had also shot Paras, but when Paras told him not to hurt me, Dipendra lowered the gun. Gyanendra and Paras are innocent, questions on Girija Prasad Koirala In her statement, Chester claimed that she had no involvement in the murder of the then Crown Prince Gyanendra and Crown Prince Paras. Chester said that the army brought Gyanendra to Kathmandu by road after the helicopter that was supposed to pick him up in Pokhara could not take off due to bad weather, and that if Gyanendra had been at the palace that night, he would have been killed too. In addition, she accused the then Prime Minister Girija Prasad Koirala of hiding the truth and committing a serious mistake. According to her, when Prime Minister Koirala, who reached the camp hospital the next day, asked what he should tell the people, Muma Badamaharani Ratna replied, "Don't hide the truth, even if it tarnishes the family's reputation, it will not harm the country." However, Chester claimed that the ban on the media and the press conference of Speaker Taranath Ranabhat had obscured the truth and spread confusion and conspiracy theories. Incomplete repentance Chester told the Nepali Times in an interview that she always regretted not being able to catch Dipendra immediately after the first shot was fired. She said, "My biggest regret to this day is that we didn't rush in and catch Dipendra that night when he fired the first shot. I blame myself for not doing so. If we had acted sooner, so many people wouldn't have died."
